out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: sushi rice.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. CFM had chef label sushi rice with 4 hour end point - 1400.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Spray bottles of bleach and soap observed without chemical name on container.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CFM had employee label bottles with chemical name.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the 2025 Food Establishment Health Department permit to operate in a conspicuous location.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. EHS WILL EMAIL ADMIN FOR A DUPLICATE PERMIT. ONCE RECEIVED PLEASE POST IT AT THE FRONT HOSTESS STAND.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO TRAIN STAFF TO KEEP PERSONAL DRINKS COVERED AND STORED IN A SEPARATE LOCATION NOT ABOVE FOOD OR PREP AREAS. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. SAKURA JAPANESE STEAK/SEAFOOD (Inspection Date: 03/25/2025) Page 3 of 5

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the sushi station hand sink, both bar hand sinks, and ladies employee restroom hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO PROVIDE PAPER TOWELS.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at multiple hand sinks at the bar and ladies employee restroom hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO PROVIDE SOAP.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at several hand sinks including the sushi station hand sink, bar hand sinks, and hand sink in the kitchen near the prep area.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS PROVIDED THE MANAGER WITH THE HAND WASHING SIGNS.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: 1) RAW ANIMAL FOODS LIKE SEAFOOD WERE STORED BELOW RAW BEEF AND RAW POULTRY INSIDE THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO RE-ORGANIZE THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR SO THAT THE RAW ANIMAL FOODS ARE ORGANIZED BY TYPE AND COOK TEMPERATURE.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) RAW ANIMAL FOODS LIKE SEAFOOD STORED ON SHELVES ABOVE SAUCES, VEGETABLES, ETC AT THE SUSHI STATION.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS HAD THE STAFF MEMBER RE-ORGANIZE THE UNITS SO THAT THE RAW SEAFOOD IS STORED BELOW SAUCES, VEGETABLES, COOKED FOODS, ETC.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) GARLIC MARGARINE OBSERVED AT 50F, 2) RICE FOR FRIED RICE OBSERVED AT 64F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS DISCUSSED PROPER COLD FOOD TEMPERATURES FOR FOODS. MANAGER WAS INSTRUCTED TO DISCARD THE FOODS NO LATER THAN 2PM (3 HOURS AFTER BRINGING OUT OF THE REFRIGERATOR). SAKURA JAPANESE STEAK/SEAFOOD (Inspection Date: 03/25/2025) Page 2 of 5

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Observed dried out (old) mouse droppings in the cabinet located below the dump sink at the sushi station and more in the dry storage area of the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the REAR KITCHEN DOOR.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO PROVIDE DOOR SWEEPS ON THE REAR DOOR TO PREVENT POSSIBLE ENTRY POINTS FOR INSECTS AND/OR RODENTS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed food stored in direct contact on the floor in the alcohol walk-in unit, walk-in freezer, and hallway near the bar.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO GET ALL ITEMS OFF THE FLOOR USING PROPER SHELVING UNITS OR DUNNAGE RACKS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: 1) OBSERVED BOWLS USED TO DISPENSE BULK FOODS, 2) OBSERVED UTENSILS IN WATER AT THE SUSHI STATION FOR MASAGO.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO KEEP NO WATER FOR THE UTENSILS UNLESS MAINTAINED HOT (ABOVE 135F) OR CONSTANTLY RUNNING AND TO USE ONLY UTENSILS WITH HANDLES AND THE HANDLES SHALL SIT UP, OUT OF THE FOOD. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers for seaweed salad and scallops were observed reused for the storage of other foods.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO DISCONTINUE THE REUSE OF MANUFACTURER CONTAINERS AND PROVIDE MORE NSF APPROVED FOOD CONTAINERS BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: 1) BROKEN DOWN CARDBOARD BOXES LINING SURFACES.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO REMOVE THE CARDBOARD AS IT IS NOT CLEANABLE. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the mop sink under constant pressure and an unapproved splitter on the threaded faucet.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO REMOVE THE UNAPPROVED SPLITTER AND THE MANAGER ORDERED THE PROPER PRESSURE BLEED DUAL VALVE. ENSURE IT IS INSTALLED BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO CLEAN THE WALLS AT THE BAR.
